items.title: Henry "Sleepy" Robertson Interview, 1961-09-22
items.q: Well we, Buddy PT and him, we played over there. I played with him.

ctx.x: We lived in Manderville. Well at the time, my mother was living in Mandeville. I live in here. But we used to go over there and play, you know. Well I'd go still with my mother the whole time. We used to play over there in Covenant, Mandeville, Slidell, because Buddy PT had all that work up and down in the coast. Well he had his bands through there and he'd pick up them fellas through there. He carried me out there with him drummer. And we'd run all through there. That time we used to have, we had an old man…
